README.md.title: DEBRIS
README.md.tagline: Ten thousand papers on plastic particles and human disease, read by machine and mapped.
README.md.why: Why it matters: the question people actually ask, what do we know about plastic particles and human disease, has no single answer anywhere, because the evidence is spread across toxicology, cardiology, obstetrics and environmental science journals that rarely cite one another and is growing every week. Asking the same questions of every abstract turns that scattered literature into something a person can see at once, including the parts of it that are empty. It is useful for: finding the papers behind a claim, telling what has been shown in people apart from what has only been shown in cells, and seeing which plastic and organ combinations nobody has studied yet.
